extracted.name: Best Chocolate Chip Cookie
extracted.description: it’s got everything a cookie lover could possibly ask for. With a texture that is slightly crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside, it’s a favorite chocolate chip cookie recipe that’s been top-rated by hundreds of satisfied home cooks.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups chocolate chips (or chunks, or chopped chocolate)
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Line a baking pan with parchment paper and set aside.
Cream together butter and sugars until combined. At Least 5 min Beat in eggs and vanilla until fluffy.
Mix in the dry ingredients until combined with a spoon, then add chocolate chips. Do not over mix this part.
Bake in preheated oven for approximately 8-10 minutes. Take them out when they are just BARELY starting to turn brown. Let them sit on the baking pan for 2 minutes before removing to cooling rack.
